text: Various presentations and announcements will be made at the City Council meeting.

Various presentations, introductions and announcements were made to City Council on March 9, 2022. Mayor Tory, during the morning session of the meeting and on behalf of City Council, recognized the on-going conflict in Ukraine and the devastating impact that the Russian invasion of Ukraine is having on millions of innocent lives. Mayor Tory noted that the City of Toronto joins the Government of Canada in continuing to condemn the attack on Ukraine and on its sovereignty and its own people. Mayor Tory added that as a representative of Toronto City Council and the people of Toronto, he expresses as much as possible, how much we stand with the people of Ukraine and with the Ukrainian-Canadian community in Toronto which is also the largest Ukrainian community, outside Ukraine, and in the world.
